resources.string: Thurea helper: keeps only the allowed app stores able to install apps, and skips, mutes and hides ads in the YouTube app. Reads only YouTube, pinned apps and Settings; nothing leaves the phone.
Thurea helper: during setup, taps through signing your accounts out and back in; after Thurea reinstalls MicroG-RE, taps Allow on its battery prompt. Never types passwords or PINs.
Your Device is protected by Thurea
